data_integrity.raw_log_manifest_algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted lines: relative-path, space, file-SHA-256, newline

measurement_scopes_and_limits.cpu: Host-frame wall time includes the measured render path and queue drain. Process CPU time and total loop wall time are separate counters.
measurement_scopes_and_limits.gpu_main: Outer main-pass timestamp. It excludes presentation and separately measured upload, and may enclose effects/offscreen work.
measurement_scopes_and_limits.gpu_stages: Upload is disjoint but not complete frame time. Effects/offscreen are attribution scopes nested within Main. Main, Upload, Effects, and Offscreen must never be summed.
measurement_scopes_and_limits.memory: Vulkan allocated bytes are Goo-tracked allocations across memory types, not physical VRAM residency. Cache/image/text are logical resident counters. Readback-pool counters cover only target readback resources.
measurement_scopes_and_limits.platform: One Linux NVIDIA RTX 3080 host; no physical Mac measurement.
measurement_scopes_and_limits.ram: RSS/private/Goo/Vulkan peaks are sparse checkpoint maxima, not continuous profilers. Managed retained peak is the maximum of forced-GC endpoints.
measurement_scopes_and_limits.statistics: Medians and ranges are over three independent run-level values. P50/P99 are computed within each 2,000-frame run; no samples are pooled and no statistical significance is claimed.
measurement_scopes_and_limits.validation: Final timing runs intentionally disabled validation. The separate 21-combination pilot qualified the same matrix with Khronos validation enabled.
measurement_scopes_and_limits.workload: All modes mutate retained-cell opacity while type-native payloads stay fixed. Results do not measure native text editing, image source changes, or shape path changes.

scope: Validation-off final timing matrix for 1,000 retained cells across all seven public Blob leaf kinds and three opacity mutation modes.

validation_and_diagnostics.drop_scope_note: Trace/result ring drops are expected bounded diagnostic-output loss and are not GPU timestamp sample/scope drops or validation-message drops.
